thread:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: v2.9.1 -> eu-west (change window 03/21 02:00-04:00 UTC). Progressive traffic: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/abcd
sofia: quick eyeball: p50 looks fine but p99 and some user errors spiking on embed-service, small 5xx bursts :thinking_face:
cheng: seeing a burst of 429/500 on /v1/generate from canary nodes, kv-cache churn looks suspicious
mike: threshold: if user-visible 5xx > 1% sustained over 10m we should pause and consider rollback
sofia: current 5m window shows 5xx = 1.3% (snapshot from dashboard), 1m is 0.9%
alice: suggest hold at 10% immediately and run quick smoke tests; don't advance to 50% yet
deploy-bot: Pausing rollout at 10% per @alice request. Canary hold engaged. Notifying monitoring and incident hooks.
cheng: collecting logs now: `kubectl -n prod logs -l svc=embed --since=10m | grep ERROR | head -n 10` -> repeating NPE in kvcache::lookup
mike: can someone reproduce with a direct canary request? `curl -v -H "x-canary: true" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
sofia: running smoke... reproduced 500 with stacktrace: `thread 'tokio-runtime' panicked at 'null pointer deref in kvcache::lookup', runtime/src/cache.rs:312`
alice: tagging runtime and model on the thread: runtime=node-421 model=llama-7b-q4_0. We shipped a kernel selection tweak in node-421 that could explain this
cheng: propose pinning canary runtime back to node-420 (previous stable) and re-run canary at 25% after pin. That avoids full rollback of model artifact
mike: +1. If pin fixes 5xx under 0.5% in 10m we can continue. If not, roll back to v2.8.x and open urgent postmortem
deploy-bot: Applying pin: runtime=node-420 to canary group. Will resume to 25% in 60s and watch SLOs.
oncall-bot: Alerting channels: eng-sre, eng-runtime, product. Notifying oncall schedule (current: @mike).
sofia: after pin: p99 latency stable, 5xx dropped to 0.2% within 3m. Logs show no kvcache NPEs on pinned nodes
mike: good signal. Maintain 25% for 15m and sample traces. If green, continue ramp. If we see any regression revert to rollback plan
alice: drafting short release note: `v2.9.1: paused kernel-selection change; pinned runtime node-420 for canary. Investigating kvcache crash.` I'll attach to the release ticket
cheng: I'll open a runtime PR to revert the heuristic that drove the new kernel selection and add a unit test for kvcache edge case
deploy-bot: Canary stable at 25% for 12m. Will auto-advance if no alerts. Manual hold remains if anyone sees an issue.
sofia: adding a short eval: run `ab -n 200 -c 10 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` against canary header to validate under load
mike: thanks all. I'll keep monitoring. If anyone sees >0.5% 5xx in next 15m call for rollback.
oncall-bot: Closing notifications for now; will reopen if automated SLO guard trips.
sofia: :thumbsup:
mike: ack
alice: thanks team, follow-ups: PRs from @cheng, release note updated, will schedule a postmortem if root cause not fully addressed
